Some editions Rema: even if unable to pray with congregation don’t delay past communal prayer time—still don’t delay time congregation prays—see below siman 90 seif 9.
Magen Avraham subparagraph 5—On Rivers of Babylon—but erev Rosh Chodesh after Minchah say Return four—Eshel Avraham below siman 232 subparagraph 4.
Some say subparagraph 10—before day—not clear—for wood piles priest arranged—invalid at night—end Yoma chapter 2—see there.
Subparagraph 11—according halacha—not settled—for we hold like Chachamim Asham requires knowledge as Rambam ruled—see his words.
(There in gloss) Eshel Avraham … here should not say Parashas Chatas ve’Asham Shelamim—for same reason—see his words.
Magen Avraham subparagraph 12—for main atonement is blood—see below siman 132 Taz subparagraph 2 and siman 234 Taz subparagraph 2.
